name: My Femboy Trainee
source: In this game you play as Andrew, or any name you like. Andrew is a sucessful type of office worker that is going through his personal hell. Life has been numb and boring. He lost motivation and he feels odd all the time. Enters Taylor, or any name you like, a new trainee in his company. In an instant, Andrew feels something towards Taylor and the interest is mutual. What will happen to their relation? Only you can decide.
